map.对企业社会责任(CSR)项目从项目设计、传播策略到效果评估进行全链路评分，涵盖社: A full-chain score of a corporate social responsibility (CSR) project from project design and communication strategy through to effect evaluation, covering five dimensions: social value, stakeholders, communication strategy, sustainability and the evaluation system.
map.📖 查看「CSR（项目/传播/评估）策划 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'CSR (Project/Communication/Evaluation) Planning'
map.CSR 项目评分 = 社会价值 + 利益相关方 + 传播策略 + 可持续性 +: CSR project score = social value + stakeholders + communication strategy + sustainability + evaluation system (0 to 5 points each, 25 in total); 21 or above is excellent, 17 to 20 is good, 12 to 16 is qualified, and below 12 is unqualified, requiring the project framework to be redesigned.
map.1. 项目社会价值与社会需求匹配度: 1. Project social value and match with social needs
map.5-评估完善且对标SDGs: 5-Complete evaluation and aligned with the SDGs
map.CSR项目应关注真实社会需求，避免\"面子工程\": CSR projects should address real social needs and avoid vanity projects
map.建议对标联合国可持续发展目标(SDGs)进行评估: Assessment against the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) is recommended
map.利益相关方包括社区、政府、NGO、员工、客户等: Stakeholders include communities, government, NGOs, employees, customers and others
map.可持续性是CSR项目的重要评价维度: Sustainability is an important evaluation dimension for CSR projects
map.CSR 项目立项前，按社会价值、利益相关方、传播策略、可持续性、评估体系 5 个: Before a CSR project is approved, score 0-5 on each of the five dimensions of social value, stakeholders, communication strategy, sustainability and the evaluation system to predict the quality of the project.
map.项目中期复盘时重评，看传播与可持续性两项是否跟上，避免「只做不说」或「一阵风」。: Re-assess at the mid-project review to see whether communication and sustainability have kept up, avoiding 'doing it but not saying it' or 'a passing flurry'.
map.把多个 CSR 选题放一起评分排序，优先推进高分且贴合企业战略的项目。: Score and rank several CSR topics together, prioritising projects that score high and fit the corporate strategy.
map.5 个维度各 0~5 分：①社会价值 ②利益相关方（覆盖与参与）③传播策略 ④可: 5 dimensions, 0-5 points each: ① social value ② stakeholders (coverage and participation) ③ communication strategy ④ sustainability ⑤ evaluation system; total = the sum of the five, 25 in total. Grades: ≥21 excellent, ≥17 good, ≥12 qualified, <12 unqualified.
map.某乡村振兴项目 社会价值5+利益相关方4+传播5+可持续4+评估4 = 22 分: A rural revitalisation project scores social value 5 + stakeholders 4 + communication 5 + sustainability 4 + evaluation 4 = 22 points, judged excellent (≥21), and the tool suggests 'roll it out'. By contrast, a tokenistic charitable donation scores social value 3 + stakeholders 3 + communication 2 + sustainability 2 + evaluation 3 = 13 points, judged qualified (≥12), but the low communication and sustainability scores flag the pattern that 'donations are easy, long-term mechanisms are weak', so communication and closed-loop evaluation need to be added.
map.CSR 评分高是否等于社会贡献大？: Does a high CSR score mean a large social contribution?
map.评分高代表「设计维度均衡、可传播可延续」，但不等于绝对贡献大。本工具是立项前的质: A high score means 'balanced, communicable and sustainable design', but it does not mean an absolutely large contribution. This tool is a quality prediction benchmark before approval; real contribution depends on the measurable outputs after delivery (beneficiaries, emission reductions, employment created, etc.). An excellent score should be a signal that the project is 'worth investing in', not proof of results.
map.为什么把「评估体系」单独列为维度？: Why is the 'evaluation system' listed as a separate dimension?
map.很多 CSR 项目败在「做了没_measure」——有活动无数据，无法向监管、E: Many CSR projects fail at 'did it but no _measure' - there are events but no data, so nothing can be reported to regulators, ESG raters or the public. Listing the evaluation system separately forces the metrics, data definitions and third-party verification to be thought through at approval time, avoiding having nothing to report at year end.
map.CSR项目评估工具从社会价值、利益相关方参与、传播策略、可持续性和效果评估5个维: The CSR project assessment tool quantifies corporate social responsibility projects across five dimensions - social value, stakeholder participation, communication strategy, sustainability and effect evaluation - helping CSR teams evaluate project quality and impact.
